reading.body:
This facility has no published power specification, no published rack or accelerator count, and no publicly available technical specifications beyond its street address in Centennial, Colorado. The operator, Charter Communications, absorbed Time Warner Cable in 2016 and operates this site as part of its internal infrastructure for cable and internet operations rather than as a marketed data center for external tenants.

Colorado has 17 mapped data center facilities on record, but only 3 publish power consumption figures totaling 26.35 megawatts across the state. This facility ranks fourth by published capacity in Colorado, which means it publishes no capacity figure at all and sits outside the state's small published total.

Without specifications for power draw, cooling, or electrical infrastructure, this campus cannot be assessed against the constraint of grid availability or the scaling capacity it might support for AI workloads. It does not appear in the operator's marketing materials or public product descriptions, and no independent technical audit of its capabilities has been published.
